evals.name: record-collection
evals.prompt: Implement a direct writer for ParcelCollected and prove what was stored.
evals.expected_output: A discovered fact and readback of its accepted position.
assertions: Uses the parcel source ID in an awaited event-log append.
Checks success then reads the same payload, source and position.

evals.name: avoid-double-write
evals.prompt: Our Arc handler returns an existing event but also appends it directly. Explain the correction.
assertions: Removes the direct append from the returning handler.
Routes Handle return details to cratis-arc-declare-command.

evals.name: reconcile-uncertain-write
evals.prompt: An import worker lost its append response. Can it acknowledge or append again?
assertions: Does not acknowledge an unknown outcome.
Reconciles by stable business identity before another non-idempotent append.
Does not use a newly generated source to evade a refusal.
